title: scrophularia ebulifolia subsp. schousboei
intro: Scrophularia ebulifolia subsp. schousboei, commonly known as Chinese figwort, is a plant species in the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). Chinese figwort is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese figwort include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory congestion, and soothe sore throats, making it a valuable remedy in traditional herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of Chinese figwort include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
